text:
### Sanctions Screening  
**Screening Requirement:**
- Customer name checked against all lists
- Transaction screening for high-risk jurisdictions
- Real-time updates (lists change daily)
- Supplementary screening (immediate family, associates)  
**Hit Processing:**
- Potential match = immediate account freeze
- Manual review of match (false positive assessment)
- If true hit = escalate to Compliance Head + immediately file NCA notice
- Account remains blocked pending resolution  
**Blocked Account Procedures:**
- No transactions permitted
- Asset freeze (prevent removal of funds)
- Customer not informed of reason (confidential)
- NCA notification (Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation, OFSI)
- Potential criminal liability

raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to check customer names against all sanctions lists with real-time updates and supplementary screening of immediate family and associates.
context: Customer name checked against all lists

raw_entities.name: Transaction Screening for High-Risk Jurisdictions
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to screen all transactions for activity involving high-risk jurisdictions as part of ongoing sanctions compliance.

raw_entities.name: Immediate Account Freeze on Potential Sanctions Match
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to immediately freeze an account upon detection of a potential match against sanctions lists, pending manual review and false positive assessment.
context: Manual review of match (false positive assessment)

raw_entities.name: Escalation to Compliance Head and NCA Notice Filing on True Hit
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to escalate confirmed sanctions matches to the Compliance Head and immediately file a notice with the National Crime Agency (NCA) upon confirmation of a true hit.
context: If true hit = escalate to Compliance Head + immediately file NCA notice

raw_entities.name: Account Remains Blocked Pending Resolution
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that accounts subject to confirmed sanctions matches remain blocked and frozen pending resolution of the compliance matter.

raw_entities.name: No Transactions Permitted on Blocked Account
raw_entities.description: Prohibition on processing any transactions on an account that has been frozen due to sanctions screening match.

raw_entities.name: Asset Freeze on Blocked Account
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to implement asset freeze on blocked accounts to prevent removal of funds pending resolution of sanctions matter.

raw_entities.name: Confidentiality of Sanctions Block Reason from Customer
raw_entities.description: Prohibition on informing the customer of the reason for account freeze or sanctions block, maintaining confidentiality of the screening match and investigation.

raw_entities.name: NCA Notification via Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to notify the National Crime Agency through the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) of confirmed sanctions matches and blocked accounts.
context: NCA notification (Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation, OFSI)

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Violation
raw_entities.description: Risk of customer or transaction involvement with sanctioned individuals, entities, or high-risk jurisdictions, exposing the bank to regulatory penalties, criminal liability, and reputational harm.
context: Customer name checked against all lists

raw_entities.name: Real-Time Sanctions List Update Mechanism
raw_entities.description: Operational control ensuring that sanctions screening lists are updated in real-time as lists change daily, maintaining current coverage of sanctioned entities and individuals.

raw_entities.name: Supplementary Screening of Family and Associates
raw_entities.description: Operational control requiring screening of immediate family members and associates of customers against sanctions lists to identify indirect sanctions evasion attempts.

raw_entities.name: Manual False Positive Assessment Process
raw_entities.description: Operational control requiring manual review of potential sanctions matches to assess and eliminate false positives before escalation and account freeze.
context: Manual review of match (false positive assessment)

raw_entities.description: Role responsible for receiving escalation of confirmed sanctions matches and overseeing the filing of NCA notices and resolution of blocked accounts.
context: escalate to Compliance Head + immediately file NCA notice

raw_entities.name: Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation
raw_entities.description: External regulatory authority responsible for receiving NCA notifications of confirmed sanctions matches and managing the UK's financial sanctions regime.
context: NCA notification (Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation, OFSI)

raw_entities.description: External regulatory authority to which the bank must file notices of confirmed sanctions matches and blocked accounts.

raw_entities.description: An account subject to sanctions screening match that has been frozen, with all transactions prohibited and assets frozen pending resolution of the compliance matter.
